ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee; no refund to rider. Optionally note the driver pressed "I'm Here" 1:35 after arrival, and remind drivers to mark arrival promptly under NS-1/A3.

rejected_claims.reason: NS-1 (ii)+(iii) satisfied from GPS/time records: driver stationary within ~40 m of Tampines Mall from 13:02:00 and held until cancellation at 13:05:40 (>3 min on scene), and pressed "I'm Here" at 13:02:45. Rider's own statement confirms she had not arrived before the 13:05:40 cancellation.
Fare breakdown contains only the $6.61 cancellation fee; no $5 waiting fee or other unpublished item was charged, so FARE-1/NS-6 do not apply.
